title: Hinomori Shizuku — What I Want To Become〔Part1〕Side Story (Part 1)

rows.Line: Miyamasuzaka Girls Academy - School Gate
Miyamasuzaka

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (Practice went so well today...)

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (We've finally settled on a course of action, so I suppose it's no wonder. I have to make sure that I'm not left behind.)

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (Oh... A red light.)

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (I was really hoping to avoid getting stuck in the middle of so many people...)

rows.Speaker: High School Student A
rows.Line:
Hey, is that Shizuku Hinomori?
The one that used to be in Cheerful * Days?

rows.Speaker: High School Student B
rows.Line:
Oh, whoa! I think so!
Damn... She's so pretty!

rows.Speaker: High School Student A
rows.Line: It feels like such a waste... I mean, quitting show business even though she's that gorgeous.

rows.Speaker: High School Student B
rows.Line: But I heard that the other members were jealous of her and picked on her because of her looks...

rows.Speaker: High School Student A
rows.Line: If that's true, she could've just kept being a model after leaving her group, right?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (Kept being a model...)

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (If I did stay as a model, would it have helped us in our search for an agency?)

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (Maybe my modeling contacts would've treated us differently when I asked them for help...)

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Hey! Heeey! Shizuku!
Can you hear me?!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Huh? A-Airi? We just parted ways and...
Why are you here?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Here. This is yours, right?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Oh, my towel...?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: You left it on the rooftop, so I picked it up for you. But I forgot to actually give it to you when we left school.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
And you came all the way here?
Thank you, Airi.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: You're welcome, but... What were you doing just now? The light turned green ages ago and you just stood there...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Oh... It did turn green. I had something on my mind and didn't notice at all...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Is that so... Well, I did manage to catch up to you because of that.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Oh, let's cross quickly before the light turns red again.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Yeah.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
You said you had something on your mind?
Can I ask what exactly?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Well...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: If you'd stayed as a model, huh...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Sure. I think I would've been much more helpful but...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: You dummy...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: There's no point in putting so much thought into what-if scenarios.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
We know what our next goal is, right?
That's all we need to think about.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Yes, I agree but...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Besides, what you really want to become is not a model, but an idol, right?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Right...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Then you should be putting that first.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Yes, you're right...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Let me ask you again, Shizuku.
What do you want to do?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I want to become an idol with you, Minori and Haruka...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I want the four of us to become idols together as MORE MORE JUMP!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
If that's true, then stop dwelling on the past!
Be more proud of what you're doing!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: More proud...?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Exactly. Because we're all right here with you!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Ah... Hehe, you're absolutely right. I can show the world that I made the right decision.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Great!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Oh, but don't stand still in front of a crosswalk when the light is green, okay? You'll just be blocking the people behind you.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Hehe. Yes, I'll be careful.
